title: Cross-Document Neural Re-Ranking via Query-Induced Subgraphs
abstract: arXiv:2406.11720v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural re-rankers typically score query-document pairs independently, neglecting cross-document context within the retrieved candidate set. We propose Graph Neural Re-Ranking (GNRR), a framework that extracts a sparse, query-induced subgraph from a pre-computed semantic corpus graph and applies Graph Neural Networks (GNN) to propagate cross-document signals. Unlike self-attention re-rankers, which scale quadratically with the number of candidates ($\mathcal{O}(K^2)$), GNRR achieves $\mathcal{O}(c \cdot K)$ online complexity, where $c$ is the fixed corpus graph degree and $K$ the candidate set size. We evaluate five GNN operators within this framework and find that architecture choice substantially affects generalization to harder queries: the GCN variant is the only one that consistently improves over TCT-ColBERT across all three TREC benchmarks. translated_title: 基于查询诱导子图的跨文档神经重排序
translated_abstract: 神经重排序器通常独立地对查询-文档对进行评分，忽略了检索候选集内的跨文档上下文。我们提出了图神经重排序（GNRR），这是一个从预先计算的语义语料库图中提取稀疏的、由查询诱导的子图，并应用图神经网络（GNN）来传播跨文档信号的框架。与随候选数量呈二次方复杂度（𝒪(K²)）增长的自我注意力重排序器不同，GNRR 实现了 𝒪(c·K) 的在线复杂度，其中 c 是固定的语料库图度数，K 是候选集大小。我们在此框架内评估了五种 GNN 算子，发现架构选择显著影响对更困难查询的泛化能力：GCN 变体是唯一在所有三个 TREC 基准测试中都持续优于 TCT-ColBERT 的变体。在最具挑战性的评估基准 TREC-DLHard 上，GNRR 实现了 +5.2% 的相对提升（原文此处不完整）。
tldr: 提出图神经重排序框架 GNRR，通过从语义语料库图中提取查询诱导子图并利用图神经网络传播跨文档信号，在实现线性在线复杂度的同时显著提升重排序性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes GNRR, a graph neural re-ranking framework that extracts query-induced subgraphs from a pre-computed semantic corpus graph and uses GNNs to propagate cross-document signals, achieving significant improvements while maintaining linear online complexity.
